name: Group answer
summary: A ranked answer to a question the group keeps asking, built from past replies, with +1s and a pin.
useWhen: a big group where the same recommendation question keeps coming back
'best dentist near campus?', 'where to get a haircut', 'good cheap laptop repair'
dontUseWhen: a fresh decision among friends (use a poll)

question.description: Short title, e.g. 'Best dentist near campus'

helped.description: Members outside the chat who found it useful, e.g. 86

asks.description: Up to 3 recent repeat posts: who, text, ago

picks.description: 2 to 5 answers: name, detail, mentions, rating 1.0-5.0, up to 2 quotes {who, text}

plus.description: Chat members' +1s: name and pick name
